'''Svein Stølen ''' (born 2 March 1960) is a [[Norwegians|Norwegian]] chemist. He has served as [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] of the [[University of Oslo]] since 2017.

==Biography==
Stølen was born in [[Fredrikstad]] on 2 March 1960. He graduated as [[cand.scient.]] in 1985 and as dr.scient. in 1988, and was appointed professor in chemistry from 1996.<ref name=snl/> His research interests have focused on structure and properties of [[inorganic compound]]s.<ref name=snl/> He was elected as the [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] of the [[University of Oslo]] for the period 2017 to 2021.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=Svein Stølen |first=Bjørn |last=Pedersen |author-link=Bjørn Pedersen |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |editor-last=Bolstad | editor-first=Erik |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=https://snl.no/Svein_Stølen  |language=Norwegian|accessdate=22 August 2017}}</ref><ref name=dn2017>{{cite news |title=Svein Stølen blir ny rektor ved Universitetet i Oslo |first=Åse |last= Gornitzka | url= https://www.dn.no/talent/2017/04/20/1622/Ase-Gornitzka/svein-stolen-blir-ny-rektor-ved-universitetet-i-oslo|date =20 April 2017 |accessdate=23 August 2017 |newspaper= [[Dagens Næringsliv ]]|language=no }}</ref> He was re-elected as rector for the period 2021 to 2025.<ref name=snl/>
